answer: Agents could earn weight through latency triangulation: each epoch, a random set of verifier nodes pings an agent and RTT bounds pin it inside a small region, so a ripple of clones on one server all land on the same knoll of coordinates and share one stake. Only agents whose distance-bounded positions differ get a haven of separate weight. Faking that costs an attacker about 1000 machines in genuinely distinct cities, kept online all epoch.
